（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / File No. S.B. 7510 / Date 26. 1. 39）

Subject Shanghai International Peace Association.

Made by C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang, Forwarded by C Crawford. S.B.

It is learned that the Shanghai International Peace
Association (上海國際和平會) with an office in Room No.409,
299 Szechuen Road, which came into existence in June 1938,
under the direction of Wu I-ting (武宜停), the principal
promoter, (vide Special Branch report dated September 23,
1938), has virtually ceased to exist since the transfer from
Shanghai of Mr. Nishimura (西村), Senior Advisor to
the Shanghai City Government, without whose continued
financial support Wu I-ting has been unable to sustain the
activities of the Association and consequently has been
inactive of late.

The lease of Room 409, 299 Szechuen Road was terminated
at the end of 1938, but Wu I-ting is reported to have stated
that a communication address would still be maintained at
46 Avenue Foch, (Chengtu Road District) in which the Hopei
Fellow Countrymen's Association is located. Wu I-ting is
at present living in the premises of the fellow countrymen's
association.

主题 上海国际和平协会。

由华籍侦探督察 Sih Tse-liang 制作，经 C Crawford 警司（特务科）转呈。

据悉，上海国际和平协会（上海國際和平會）办事处位于四川路299号409室，该组织于1938年6月在主要发起人武宜停（Wu I-ting，音译：武宜停）的指导下成立（参见1938年9月23日的特务科报告），自上海市政府高级顾问西村先生（Mr. Nishimura，音译：西村）离沪后，该协会实际上已不复存在；由于失去了西村持续的财政支持，武宜停无法维持协会的活动，因此近期一直处于停滞状态。

四川路299号409室的租约已于1938年底终止，但据报武宜停曾表示，仍将保留福煦路46号（成都路区）作为通讯地址，该处为河北同乡会所在地。武宜停目前居住在该同乡会的 premises 内。

September 21, 1938. Morning Translation.

News Digest:

THE SHANGHAI INTERNATIONAL PEACE ASSOCIATION

This paper yesterday received several copies
of a pamphlet entitled "Manifesto for Peace issued by the
Shanghai International Peace Association". The pamphlet
contains ridiculous statements and had apparently been
issued by shameless traitors.
In its covering letter to this paper, the
Association stated that it had "submitted a report to
the Shanghai Municipal Council". This is very surprising.
This traitorous organization has an office
at 46 Avenue Foch, Telephone 35177. The address of
the Association as printed on the pamphlet is Room 409,
Oriental Building, 299 Szechuen Road.

（批：Si / Any connection with Wu Liang? / To L）

1938年9月21日。上午译文。

新闻摘要：

上海国际和平协会

本报昨日收到数本名为《上海国际和平协会发布的和平宣言》的小册子。该小册子包含荒谬的言论，显然出自无耻汉奸之手。
该协会在给本报的附信中称，已“向上海公共租界工部局提交了一份报告”。这令人非常惊讶。
这个叛国组织的办公室位于福煦路46号，电话35177。小册子上印制的协会地址为四川路299号东方大楼409室。

September 22, 1938.
Morning Translation.

Ta Mei Wan Pao of September 21:

"INTERNATIONAL PEACE SOCIETY" ISSUES MANIFESTO

Many people in Shanghai have of late received copies of a manifesto issued by a so-called "Shanghai International Peace Society" (上海國際和平會). The manifesto states that it has reported its formation to the S.M.C.

The manifesto gives the office of the Society at No.409, in the building of the Bank of East Asia, No.299 Szechuen Road, but on the letters sent by the Society to the public the communication office is given as No.46 Avenue Foch, Telephone 35177. Certain persons who telephoned to this address were informed that this is address of the Hopei Fellow Countrymen's Association and that there was no such body as the "Shanghai International Peace Society" located there.

A perusal of the manifesto shows that the peace movement of the "Shanghai International Peace Society" is being directed by the Japanese. The propaganda literature of the Society makes no mention of the promoters.

It will be remembered that sometime ago, the Hopei Fellow Countrymen's Association was the object of a bomb attack.

上午译文。

9月21日《大美晚报》：

“国际和平社”发布宣言

上海许多人最近收到了一份所谓“上海国际和平社”（上海國際和平會）发布的宣言副本。宣言称，其成立已向工部局报备。

宣言给出该社办公室位于四川路299号东亚银行大楼409室，但在该社发给公众的信件上，通讯地址列为福煦路46号，电话35177。某些拨打此地址电话的人被告知，这是河北同乡会的地址，那里并没有所谓的“上海国际和平社”这一机构。

细读宣言可知，“上海国际和平社”的和平运动正由日本人指导。该社的宣传文献中未提及发起人。

记得不久前，河北同乡会曾是炸弹袭击的目标。

Date September 25, 1938.

Subject Propaganda activities of the Shanghai International
Peace Association.

Made by C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by C. Crawford. D. J.

The pamphlet entitled "Manifesto for Peace
issued by the Shanghai International Peace Association",
mentioned in the local Chinese press, is actually issued
by the Shanghai International Peace Association, now
located at Room 409 Bank of East Asia Building, 299
Szechuen Road, of which the principal promoter is Wu
I-ting ( 武 宜 停 ).

Wu I-ting submitted an application for regis-
tration to the Special Branch, Police Headquarters on
June 23, but no registration certificate was issued.

With reference to the office situated at 46
Avenue Foch, as mentioned in the newspaper cutting, this
address is actually the Hopei Fellow Countrymen's Asso-
ciation, of which Wu I-ting is nominally one of the
committee members but actually holds the reins of the
Association. It is, however, to be noted that the
decision of the Municipal Police to prohibit any propa-
ganda activities being carried out on the premises of the
Countrymen's Association on behalf of this so-called
"Peace" organization, was conveyed to Mr. Ling Ts Kwong
( 靈 芝 光 ), another committee member of the Fellow
Countrymen's Association, on June 23, and since that time
no outward sign of any resumption of such activities at
46 Avenue Foch has come to our notice, but there is every
possibility that any mail to the "Peace" Association will
be invariably accepted at 46 Avenue Foch, although personal
visit or enquiry at the same address regarding this peace
movement will undoubtedly bring an answer in the negative.

主题 上海国际和平协会的宣传活动的。

由华籍侦探督察 Sih Tse-liang 制作，经 C. Crawford. D. J. 转呈。

当地中文报刊中提到的名为《上海国际和平协会发布的和平宣言》的小册子，确实由上海国际和平协会发布，该协会现位于四川路299号东亚银行大楼409室，其主要发起人为武宜停（ 武 宜 停 ）。

武宜停曾于6月23日向警察总局特务科提交注册申请，但未颁发注册证书。

关于剪报中提到的位于福煦路46号的办公室，该地址实际上是河北同乡会，武宜停名义上是该会委员之一，但实际上掌控着该会。然而，需要注意的是，市政警察禁止在该同乡会 premises 内代表这个所谓的“和平”组织进行任何宣传活动的决定，已于6月23日传达给同乡会另一位委员灵芝光先生（ Mr. Ling Ts Kwong， 靈 芝 光 ），自那时以来，我们未注意到福煦路46号有任何恢复此类活动的明显迹象，但寄给“和平”协会的任何邮件极有可能仍会在福煦路46号被接收，尽管在同一地址亲自拜访或询问有关此和平运动的事宜，无疑会得到否定的答复。

January 20, 1939. Afternoon Translation.

Lieh Pao (立報), a mosquito paper:

A STRANGE BOOKLET

Yesterday a certain person received from the
post a parcel of printed matter. On opening it, he
noticed that it contained slogans supporting Wong Ching-
wei and a booklet of legislative regulations of the
Chinese Republic of Provisional Federal States. On the
left side of the cover of the booklet appears the
signature "Woo Nyi-ding" (武宜停). Nothing is known
of the antecedents of this person but he seems to have
a fair knowledge of the feeling among certain nationals
who are tired of the war and are eager for an early
conclusion. The three characters he has used as his
name mean that the hostilities should be stopped.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:

THE UNION BREWERY COMPANY

Of late, reports have been current to the
effect that the Union Brewery Company, a British concern,
is making arrangements for its sale to Japanese
merchants.
The company, however, declares that the
report is absolutely untrue.

Eastern Times:

A SHANGHAI DISTRICT COURT

It is learned that after the inauguration
of the Shanghai District Court, the Judicial Office of
the Shanghai Special Municipal Government will change
its title to Shanghai District Branch Court. It will
be located in Pootung for it would be ridiculous to
have two Shanghai District Courts at the same side of
the Whangpoo.

1939年1月20日。下午译文。

蚊报《立报》：

一本奇怪的小册子

昨天某人收到邮包一件印刷品。打开后，他发现其中包含支持汪精卫的标语以及中华民国临时联邦政府的立法法规小册子。小册子封面左侧署名为“Woo Nyi-ding”（武宜停，音译：武宜停）。对此人的背景一无所知，但他似乎相当了解某些厌倦战争、渴望早日结束战事的国民的情绪。他用作姓名的三个字意味着应停止敌对行动。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

联合啤酒公司

最近有传闻称，英商联合啤酒公司正在安排将其出售给日本商人。
然而，该公司声明该报道完全不实。

《字林西报》：

上海地方法院

据悉，在上海地方法院成立后，上海特别市政府司法办公室将更名为上海地方法院分院。它将位于浦东，因为在黄浦江同一侧设立两个上海地方法院将是荒谬的。

July 9, 1938. Morning Translation.

Morning Leader publishes the following letters :-

PROPAGANDA SENT THROUGH THE POST

To the Editor $
Since Shanghai became an isolated island,
many foxes, dogs and rascals have, with the support of the
"short fellows", become important persons.
Yesterday morning we received by post six
pamphlets in red and green issued by shameless persons
to propagate the betrayal of the country. The pamphlets
were entitled "Letter from Wu Nyi-ding (武宜停) to
Discuss the Salvation of the Country and People with the
Various Circles Throughout the Country". The pamphlet
suggests the immediate cessation of our war of resistance
and the cultivation of friendship with Japan.
Our talented Mr. Wu informs us in the
pamphlet that for the purpose of promoting Sino-Japanese
and world peace, he has established a "Shanghai International
Peace Society" on Museum Road and is seeking the co-operation
of the people.
Considerable effect will no doubt be produced
by sending the propaganda through the post, but I hope
that persons who receive the pamphlet will first ask
themselves whether they are prepared to follow in the
steps of such "big men" as Loh Pah-hong (陸伯鴻) and Koo
Shing-ih (顧馨一).
My advice to my fellow-countrymen is that
they remain unshaken in the war of resistance.
Chiu Tsing (火疑).

To the Editor $
The day before yesterday our shop received
an unsigned letter containing more than ten strange pamphlets,
similar to one picked up in front of the Sun Sun Company
the other day by a friend of mine named Han (韓). They
are purely propaganda sent out by traitors for a certain
party. This propaganda is useless because our Government
has already decided to resist the Japanese bandits to the
end. I hope our fellow-countrymen will not be misled
by the traitors.
Ching Chun (勁軍).
(Editor's notes- All efforts of the traitors
will be in vain if our countrymen are firm in the war of
resistance. We think that the youths and patriotic
persons in Shanghai should go about the various classes
of people to carry out propaganda work. They will not
only make patriotic persons more patriotic, but make
traitors repent.)

1938年7月9日。上午译文。

《晨报》刊登以下信件：-

通过邮政发送的宣传品

致编辑 $
自从上海成为孤岛以来，许多狐群狗辈和无赖在“矮个子”的支持下，成了重要人物。
昨天上午，我们收到邮递来的六本红绿色小册子，由无耻之徒发布，宣扬卖国。这些小册子题为《武宜停（Wu Nyi-ding，音译：武宜停）与全国各界讨论救国救民书》。小册子建议立即停止我们的抗战，并与日本修好。
我们才华横溢的吴先生在小册子中告诉我们，为了促进中日及世界和平，他在博物馆路建立了一个“上海国际和平社”，并正在寻求民众的合作。
通过邮政发送宣传品无疑会产生相当大的影响，但我希望收到小册子的人先问问自己，是否准备追随陆伯鸿（Loh Pah-hong，音译：陆伯鸿）和顾馨一（Koo Shing-ih，音译：顾馨一）等“大人物”的脚步。
我对同胞的建议是，在抗战中保持坚定不动摇。
Chiu Tsing（火疑）。

致编辑 $
前天本店收到一封匿名信，内含十多本奇怪的小册子，类似于我的朋友韩（Han）前几天在新新公司门前捡到的一本。这些纯粹是汉奸为某一方发出的宣传品。这种宣传是无用的，因为我国政府已决定抵抗日寇到底。希望我国同胞不要被汉奸误导。
Ching Chun（劲军）。
（编者注——如果我国同胞坚持抗战，汉奸的一切努力都将徒劳。我们认为上海的青年和爱国人士应深入各阶层人群开展宣传工作。这不仅会使爱国者更加爱国，也会使汉奸悔悟。）

NEW ORGANIZATION
SAID FORMED
Co-operative Group Has
Nucleus Of Several
Aged People

Despite Chinese terrorist activities directed against what they term "puppets" working in co-operation with the Japanese, a new Chinese organization, aiming at promoting friendship with the Japanese has been started in Shanghai and is trying to enlist members.

According to a Chinese report, Mr. W. Yi-ting has organized the International Peace Society at the request of the Japanese. The chief aims of the Society are to promote friendly feelings between the Chinese and Japanese and to try its best to bring an end to the present hostilities.

Under his name, an open letter, entitled "Letter to all Fellow-Countrymen in Connection with the Salvation of the Nation and People" sets forth the aims of his organization. Under the Society there has been established the "Shanghai Autonomous Bureau," the chief aim of which is to oppose the resistance policy.

The Society is trying to get members, but only a few persons are said to be willing to join it. It has secured several aged people as its "fundamental" members.

尽管中国人针对他们所称的与日本人合作的“傀儡”开展了恐怖活动，但上海已成立一个新的中国组织，旨在促进与日本的友好关系，并正试图招募成员。

据中文报道，W. Yi-ting 先生应日本人的要求组织了国际和平社。该社的主要目标是促进中日之间的友好感情，并尽力结束目前的敌对状态。

以他的名义发表的一封公开信，题为《关于拯救国家与人民致全体同胞书》，阐述了他的组织的目标。在该社之下已成立“上海自治局”，其主要目标是反对抵抗政策。

该社正试图招募成员，但据说只有少数人愿意加入。它已争取到几位老年人作为其“基本”成员。

Moon are shining. Comrades and friends started an
autonomous movement at Shiang Ho to reconstruct the
nation and to improve the people's livelihood. The
Chairman of the Honan Provincial Government, General
Shang Tseng, did not support this movement; otherwise
the whole nation would have participated and the
present disaster would have been avoided. I don't
know when the disaster will come to an end and I
weep whenever I think that China is now following
the steps of Spain. National salvation without
confidence is useless. None can avoid death. To
know a thing is difficult and to do it is easy. The
Sleepy lion is roaring and many heroes are working
for the realization of self-determination and self-
government. The recovery of Manchuria is to be
effected during the "three autumns". Please don't
worry as defeats will result in victory. If you
ask for the reason, I tell you that combination and
separation are inter-changing. We should stop the
war and carry out struggles by peaceful measures.
This is universal truth.

The heaven and the earth, and the earth and the heaven.
Happiness follows misfortune.
Afford equal treatment to the people of the
same race and be friendly with one another; which

CHAPTER 1 - General Principles

Article 1 - The Self-Government Guild for the Municipality
of Shanghai is organized for the purpose of seeking
world peace and for the enforcement of the
principles of cosmopolitanism.

Article 2 - The Self-Government Guild is organized by
representatives of the heads of families.

Article 3 - The heads of families,irrespective of nativity
and nationality, who wish to live in Shanghai
and of whom records have been kept by the Census
Department of the local administration, will be
entitled to elect or to be elected as officers
of the Guild.

Article 4 - Forty nine representatives will be elected by
the heads of families in Shanghai residing in
the following divisions :-

Nantao
Chapei
Pootung
Western District
International Settlement
French Concession.

Article 5 - The number of representatives of a division
to the Guild will be in proportion to the number
of families residing in that division.

Article 6 - The election of representatives to the Guild
will be by ballot. Heads of families□□□□□□□□
also be elected.

June 13, 1938. Afternoon Translation

Standard :-

A LETTER FROM THE FOUNDER OF SHANGHAI INTERNATIONAL PEACE
ASSOCIATION

Yesterday this paper received a letter from Wu
Hyien-ding (武宜傳), founder of the Shanghai International
Peace Association. At first we decided to ignore the letter,
but after perusing it we are of the opinion that it is not
fair for us to keep such a "wonderful letter" to ourselves.
Therefore, we publish the letter for the information of our
readers but we hope that they will not misunderstand this as
propaganda on behalf of others.

FILE
20

"To the editor,
Yesterday your paper published an article
entitled 'Why are there so many devils' which had been
reproduced from the 'China Press.' The article not only
falsely accuses me of having organized the Shanghai Inter-
national Peace Association at the instigation of the Japanese,
but also makes the ridiculous mistake of giving the address
of the association as Yuen Ming Yuen Road whereas in reality
it is located on Museum Road.
I assure you that the peace I am advocating is
a cultural peace and not peace by armed force; the object of
my association is solely to relieve the people.
I hope you will publish a correction which will
be appreciated not only by me but also by the people who are
waiting for a helping hand. I am forwarding you some
propaganda literature of my association and hope you will
kindly help me with your advice. Your criticisms will be
much appreciated.

Wu Hyien-ding,
Founder of the Shanghai International
Peace Association,
June 11."

标准：-

上海国际和平协会创始人来信

本报昨日收到上海国际和平协会创始人武宜传（Wu Hyien-ding）的来信。起初我们决定不予理睬，但细读之后，我们认为若将这样一封“奇信”私藏而不公开，实非公允之举。因此，现刊登此信以供读者知悉，但我们希望读者不要误解这是为他人做宣传。

档案
20

“致编辑：
贵报昨日刊登了一篇题为《为何有如此多的魔鬼》的文章，该文转载自《字林西报》（China Press）。这篇文章不仅诬蔑我是在日本人的唆使下组织了上海国际和平协会，还犯了一个荒谬的错误，将该会的地址写为圆明园路，而实际上该会位于博物馆路。
我向你们保证，我所倡导的和平是文化和平，而非武力和平；本会的宗旨 solely 在于救济民众。
希望你们刊登一则更正启事，这不仅是我个人的期望，也是那些等待援助之手的人们的期望。现随信附上本会的一些宣传文献，希望你们能 kindly 给予建议。你们的批评将不胜感激。

武宜传，
上海国际和平协会创始人，

发起人在此展开
“和平”机构计划

随着无数旨在促进当地外籍人士与中国居民在中日战争期间友好合作的组织加入上海的历史篇章，昨日又有此类组织流传开来。吴启定（Wu Kee-ding，音译），被描述为一位“教育家”，已从北平抵达此处，以启动“国际和平协会”。吴及其随从秘书和助手已在博物馆路的中华基督教协进会大楼（Christian Literature Building）开设办事处。一份印刷的小册子概述了该组织的目的，并引用了许多孟子的语录。在提及日本人为“伟大和平的民族”时，小册子解释说，建立该协会的目的是“首先使中国和日本成为一家人，其次使全世界各国成为一个大的和平联盟……”小册子接着说：“既然我们所信奉的古代圣贤的伟大教义可能与日本人所谓的大陆政策相一致，那么中国人和日本人联合起来，就像天地一样，像呼吸一样自然。”

在概述上海应如何治理时，该协会的发起人提议：“在上海形成公共自治的方式是，每个家庭的首领，不分国籍，都应组织起来，真正践行道德和科学原则，并且该政府应与现有政府合作开展各项工作。”

需要大量职员
根据小册子，该组织将设一名主席和两名副主席，五个委员会各40名成员，20名部门主管以及若干秘书。以下为部分委员会选定的名称：
“公共信息委员会”、
“公共教育委员会”、
“就业办公室委员会”、
“宗教事务委员会”、
以及“财产控制委员会”。

A letter issued by Wu I-ting on the question of the ||
Salvation of the Nation and the People.

1) The bombing of Hsuchow (in Kiangsu) and Foochow (in Fukien) by Japanese aircraft is the result of the invasion of Japan by one Hsu Foo in the reign of Emperor Zing Shih Huang about two thousand years ago. Most of the Japanese subjects are undoubtedly the descendants of Hsu Foo and his followers. We must immediately patch up a truce with the Japanese, as we are responsible for the armed conflict.

2) Wu I-ting was a member of the Kuomintang ten years ago, but he did not accept any official appointment, because he knew that by so doing he could be the saver of the lives of members of the Kuomintang ten years later when they would be involved in a combat with others. Now that the country is engaged in a life and death struggle with Japan, it is my duty to be mediator between Japan and China.

3) To love one's home is more imp rtant than one's country. The people should telegraph General Executive Chiang Kai-shek, requesting him to order a cessation of the hostilities so that the homes of the people can be preserved.

4) The Chinese people should unite and request the Japanese Emperor to issue a rescript ordering a truce in order to save the lives of Chinese troops and to relieve the people of China and Japan of their sufferings attendant upon an armed conflict between these two states.

5) After the cessation of hostilities, the troops of both China and Japan should help the Chinese people to enforce a system of self-government and to organize self-government guilds for various districts.

6) The members of the Kuomintang are responsible for the present conflict with Japan. If self-government guilds are established, these will be staffed by heads of families, giving no chance to the Kuomintang members to participate in the administration of municipal and state affairs.

7) In order to carry out the above plans, an International Peace Association has been established with an office in Room, 533, Christian Literature Society Building, Museum Road, and rules and regulations governing the formation of a self-government guild for the Municipality of Shanghai have been prepared.

Preamble to the Regulations of the
Shanghai International Peace Association
------
"Give what others desire, and take what they cast away" said
Lao Tzu. This is the way for universal peace and it also represents
the virtue of the Chinese people. The present Chinese nation, vest-
ing its powers in the people, is called a "commonwealth of peace".
In reality, it is only a government which shares its powers with
the governed. At first, the more crafty persons arrogated to them-
selves the rights abandoned by the simple-minded; there was still
peace. Soon after, those who were in power had all the advantages,
and those who had given up their rights were victimized. Though
the powers of government were still shared by a majority, yet peace
there was none. Persons who were well versed in politics saw through
this trouble. They brought equality to the different strata of the
common people by confiscating their rights and restricting their
freedom. As a result, the government thrived at the expense of the
people and all the rights of citizens were controlled by the state.
This was how Emperor Hung Hsien (憲 法) came into existence
and why there have been so many militarists and corrupt officials.
The late Dr. Sun Yat-sen was also aware of this weakness in our
national system. He sought to effect a cure by applying a native
medicine under a foreign name. He classified political powers into
four categories, and prescribed three stages for the training of
citizens. The measures he advocated were well adapted to his
principles. Unfortunately, he died before the completion of the
political tutelage period. His followers, with their dead master as
a puppet, have gone far astray from the original doctrine so that the
period of political tutelage now exists only in name. They regard
the people as playthings and ignore their rights. In their struggle
for power, they first admitted Communists into their own ranks, then
sought to expel and exterminate them. In their eager pursuit for
advantages, they first befriended the Japanese, then turned against
them. They did not know that Nature would have its revenge. This

------
“既以为人己愈有，既以与人己愈多”（注：此处原文引文为意译，对应老子思想），老子如是说。此乃通往世界和平之道，亦代表中国人民之美德。当今中华民国，权在于民，被称为“和平共和”。实则，这只是一个统治者与被统治者分享权力的政府。起初，较为狡黠之人攫取了淳朴者所放弃的权利；那时尚存和平。不久之后，掌权者占尽优势，而放弃权利者则沦为受害者。尽管政府权力仍由多数人分享，但已无和平可言。精通政治之人看穿了这一弊病。他们通过没收民众权利并限制其自由，使平民各阶层趋于平等。结果，政府以牺牲人民为代价而繁荣，公民的所有权利皆受国家控制。洪宪皇帝（憲 法）[注：此处原文将“宪法”与袁世凯洪宪帝制混淆或特指某种体制] 由此产生，军阀与贪官污吏之所以如此众多，原因即在于此。已故孙中山博士也意识到我国体制中的这一弱点。他试图借洋名行中药之实来加以 cure（治愈）。他将政治权力分为四类，并为公民训练规定了三个阶段。他所倡导的措施与其原则甚为契合。不幸的是，他在政治训政时期完成之前便去世了。他的追随者们以其亡师为傀儡，严重背离了原始教义，致使政治训政时期如今仅存其名。他们视人民为玩物，无视其权利。在争夺权力的斗争中，他们先是允许共产党人加入其行列，随后又寻求驱逐并消灭他们。在急切追求利益的过程中，他们先是与日本交好，随后又转而反对日本。他们不知天道好还，必施报复。此

page_data.en:
is why Communists and bandits have again thrived and the Japanese
have invaded us on the pretext of fighting against Communism and
banditry.
Alas! The nation will soon be no longer a nation; of what use
are its political powers? The people will cease to be protected
by a government; of what use is personal wealth? What is strangest
is that China, a democratic nation, is not pursuing its policy
of peace, but has joined hands with Communists and is fighting
against Japan. On the other hand, the Wa Ho (和 太)(Great
Harmony) race of Japan has also abandoned its peaceful tradition
and has invaded China. Both countries have forsaken the very
virtue for which they were reputed, and have failed to practice
the principle of kindness. Two sister nations have now become
enemies resorting to brute force. One cannot but shudder to think
of the future.
I have therefore ventured to start an International Peace
Movement and have formulated regulations for the formation of an
Association in Shanghai. My object is to cure a national illness
with a native remedy. This remedy I shall call "Self Government".
When every person governs himself, the people are mutually governed,
and where there is mutual government, there is also self-government.
To carry out this scheme the heads of families shall bear the
principal burden. When the family is well ordered, the community
will be stabilized and the country will also become peaceful.
All those who wish to live in this country, to continue living, and
to bring up families here should join this Self Government without
regard as to their nationalities.
The Self Government advocated above may be styled a "Self
Government for Universal Peace". The ancient Chinese believed in
a world-wide open door policy. Under this Self Government, Japan
can also pursue its ambition in the Asiatic Continent without

2.
page_data.zh:
即共产党人与匪徒再次猖獗，以及日本以剿共灭匪为借口入侵我国的原因。
唉！国家将不久不复为国家，其政治权力又有何用？人民将不再受政府保护，个人财富又有何用？最奇怪的是，中国作为一个民主国家，不推行其和平政策，反而与共产党联手对抗日本。另一方面，日本的 Wa Ho（和 太）（大和）民族也放弃了其和平传统，入侵中国。两国都抛弃了赖以成名的美德，未能践行仁爱原则。两个姊妹邦如今已成为诉诸武力的敌人。思及未来，令人不寒而栗。
因此，我冒昧发起国际和平运动，并制定了在上海成立协会的章程。我的目的是以本土良药治愈国家痼疾。此药我将称之为“自治”。当人人自治时，民众便相互治理；既有相互治理，便有自治。为实施此方案，家长应承担主要责任。家齐则社区稳定，国家亦将和平。所有希望在此国度生活、生存并在此养育家庭的人，不论国籍如何，均应加入此自治组织。
上述倡导的自治可称为“世界和平自治”。古代中国人信奉天下开放政策。在此自治之下，日本亦可追求其在亚洲大陆的野心，而不

page_data.en:
resorting to warfare and killing on a vast scale. When such a
Self Government for Universal Peace is established, there will be
accord among all parties. The Chinese and the Japanese, who
belong to the same race and have similar languages, can naturally
live and prosper together. There will be no need of any campaign
against either Communism or banditry. In the end, the two people,
being of the same race and sharing the same civilization, will
become one. There will also be no necessity for one country to
conquer the other. Then, all those who wish to become government
officials will come to China, as well as all farmers, businessmen
and travellers. Moreover, those who have grievances against their
own government will appeal to us for redress. Is not such a
Self Government a splendid and satisfactory achievement and who
will be able to resist its ever-growing strength? Will all
supporters of world peace come and join this movement!

---

3.

必诉诸大规模战争与杀戮。当此种世界和平自治建立时，各方将和谐共处。同种同文的中国人和日本人自然可以共同生活并繁荣发展。无需进行任何反共或剿匪运动。最终，同种同文明的两国人民将合二为一。亦无需一国征服另一国。届时，所有希望成为政府官员的人，以及所有农民、商人和旅行者都将来到中国。此外，那些对自己政府不满的人也将向我们申诉以求公正。这样的自治难道不是辉煌且令人满意的成就吗？谁又能抵挡其日益增长的力量呢？愿所有世界和平的支持者前来加入此运动！

Art.1. Name. The object of the association is to seek world peace and
to foster friendship among nations. As China is the permanent
member of the association, and the World Peace Movement starts
in Shanghai, the name of the association shall be "The
Shanghai International Peace Association".

Art.2 Procedure. The association shall first consider and deal with
the grievances of Chinese people and then those of the Japanese
After this, attention shall be paid to the differences between
other nations.

Art.3 Method. The Shanghai Municipality shall be governed by the
people in accordance with the principles of justice. A self-
government society shall be organized by heads of families of
different nationalities to cooperate with the local City
Government. This practice may apply to other cities.

Art.4 Membership. Any person, regardless of sex and nationality
who supports the object of this association and pays member-
ship fee according to these regulations be eligible for
membership.

Art.5 Term. It is estimated that the object of this Association can
be attained within three years. The term of the Association
shall, therefore, expire at the end of the 50th Year of the
Chinese Republic. At the expiration of the term the Associa-
tion shall either be dissolved or reorganized.

Shanghai International Peace Association.

MILITANT DEFENCE
OF PEACE!

Closure Of The World
Peace Conference
At Brussels

FINAL FLOURISH BY
BRITISH WOMAN

BRUSSELS, Sept. 6. — After
several days of deliberations, the
“World Peace Conference” closed
here yesterday with the adoption
of a final resolution inviting “....
all peoples to engage in a mili-
tant defence of peace.”

“We address this fervent ap-
peal,” the resolution states, “to
bring the participation of all in
a comprehensive campaign we are
sponsoring and which, interdict-
ing all meddling in international
politics, has but one aim: to assure
for all countries, large and small,
without distinction and with com-
plete equality, peace. Our sole
enemy would be the aggressor
who violates international law and
who destroys world peace....”

Lord Robert Cecil, Chairman of
the British League of Nations
Union, Lord Lytton, ex-Viceroy of
India and head of the Lytton
Commission to Manchuria, and M.
Marcel Cachin, French Communist
Senator, were present at the clos-
ing session.

The final meeting was marked
by an incident when Miss Vera
Vincent, a British citizen, broke
into the room, dressed in blue and
brandishing an “international flag”
—her own invention—declaring
that she was a delegate from “The
Union of Mothers of the World.”
She then started to explain the
programme of her organization,
which, she said, contains the most
beautiful idea in the world, when
guards intervened and accom-
panied her out of the room.—
Havas.

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, SATURDAY, SEPTEMBER 5, 1936

CHINA'S ONLY WAY
TO SALVATION

Defence Against Foreign
Aggression

NON-RESISTANCE SAID
IMPOSSIBLE

Brussels, Sept. 4.
"China is at present passing through an unprecedented national crisis," Dr. Shelley Wang, a member of the Chinese delegation, declared yesterday in speaking at the opening meeting of the Universal Peace Conference here.
Affirming China's adherence to the cause of peace, Dr. Wang recalled that since the Manchurian Incident of September 18, 1931, China was in the grip of that crisis.
"To put an end to the civil war, our people, whose profoundly peaceful spirit is well-known, must become organized, so as to take part in the vast movement for peace.
"If every worker, peasant or soldier refuses to fight for a warlord under any pretext whatever, unwilling to shed the blood of his compatriots, peace will be ensured within our country. However, in the event of foreign aggression, there is only one way to salvation, and that is defence. Pacifism interpreted as non-resistance or as resistance which exhausts itself in impotent gestures, is impossible. However, resistance does not necessarily mean a world war. Peace may be achieved through efficacious collective security and veritable mutual assistance. Hence, the League of Nations must be strengthened."
The Chinese delegation includes the playwright, Prof. S. I. Hsiung, translator of "Lady Precious Stream."

Fundamental Principles
Thirty-two nations are represented at the conference, whose purpose is to examine means for outlawing war. Germany is not represented.
Participants base their position on three fundamental principles:
Recognition of the inviolability of treaty obligations;
Reduction and limitation of Armaments by international accords, and taking the profits out of the production of and trade in arms; and
Enforcement of the provisions of the League of Nations.
The largest delegation is from France, which sent 3,500 representatives, only a small part of whom were able to enter the meeting. The leader of the delegation is the French Air Minister, M. Pierre Cot, who is being assisted by M. Raoul Aubaud, Under-Secretary of Interior; Mme. Brunschwig, Under-Secretary of National Education; M. Edouard Herriot, ex-Premier and President of the Chamber; and 40 members of parliament of the Radical-Socialist, Socialist and Communist parties.
The British group, which is the second largest, and which comprises 500 individuals, is presided over by Lord Cecil, President of the League of Nations Union.

M. Herriot's Speech
Senor Carlos Alverez, Spanish delegate, received a tremendous ovation when he appeared, making the leftist salute of the upraised fist, to which a majority of the delegates responded with the same gesture.
M. Edouard Herriot recalled efforts he had made, during the past twelve years, in the name of France, to establish a chart for peace based on this strong formula: arbitration, security, and disarmament. "Let us reflect upon it well that our sole resource against war, our only hope, is to realize in the international order that which is already obtained in the national orders," he said. "It is to assure the intangibility of contracts... It is also necessary to watch over and prevent this rising course of armaments, which had ceased, and which has to-day taken an accelerated rhythm."
M. Herriot also recommended the nationalization of the manufacture of arms, collective security, and the principle of mutual assistance.—Havas.

布鲁塞尔，9月4日电。
“中国目前正经历着前所未有的民族危机，”中国代表团成员王博士（Dr. Shelley Wang）昨日在此间举行的世界和平大会开幕会议上发言时宣称。
王博士在肯定中国致力于和平事业的同时回顾道，自1931年9月18日满洲事变以来，中国一直深陷这场危机之中。
“为了结束内战，以崇尚和平精神著称的我国人民必须组织起来，以便参与庞大的和平运动。
“如果每一位工人、农民或士兵以任何借口拒绝为军阀作战，不愿流淌同胞的鲜血，那么我国内部的和平就能得到保障。然而，一旦面临外国侵略，唯一的救赎之道就是防御。将和平主义诠释为不抵抗，或诠释为徒劳无功的姿态式的抵抗，是不可能的。然而，抵抗并不必然意味着世界大战。通过有效的集体安全和真正的互助，可以实现和平。因此，必须加强国际联盟。”
中国代表团成员包括剧作家熊式一教授，他是《王宝钏》（Lady Precious Stream）的译者。

基本原则
共有三十二个国家派代表参加此次会议，其目的是审查宣布战争非法的手段。德国未派代表参加。
与会者基于三项基本原则确立其立场：
承认条约义务的神圣不可侵犯；
通过国际协定裁减和限制军备，并从武器生产和贸易中去除利润；以及
执行国际联盟的各项规定。
最大的代表团来自法国，派遣了3,500名代表，其中只有一小部分得以进入会场。代表团团长是法国空军部长皮埃尔·科特先生，协助他的有：内政部次长拉乌尔·奥博先生、国民教育部次长布伦施维格夫人、前总理兼众议院议长爱德华·赫里欧先生，以及来自激进社会党、社会党和共产党的40名议员。
英国代表团规模第二大，由500人组成，由国联协会主席塞西尔勋爵主持。

西班牙代表卡洛斯·阿尔韦雷斯先生出场时举起拳头行左翼礼，获得了热烈的欢呼，大多数代表也以同样的手势回应。
爱德华·赫里欧先生回顾了过去十二年里，他以法国的名义，基于“仲裁、安全、裁军”这一有力公式，为建立和平宪章所作的努力。“让我们深思，我们对付战争的唯一资源、唯一希望，就是在国际秩序中实现那些已在国内秩序中获得的东西，”他说。“这就是要确保契约的神圣不可侵犯……此外，还必须监视并防止军备增长的上升趋势，这种增长曾一度停止，但如今又以加速的节奏重新出现。”
赫里欧先生还建议实行武器制造国有化、集体安全以及互助原则。——哈瓦斯社。

With reference to the attached translation of an article

that the gentleman referred to is William Edward DODD, Jr., son

W.E. Dodd, Jr. was born thirty years ago at Ashland, Vir-
ginia, U.S.A. and is a professor of the William and Mary College,
Virginia. During the current summer vacation he became an
organiser of the International Peace Campaign, a movement
sponsored by Viscount Robert Cecil in England during 1935 and
which has rapidly extended its influence all over the globe.
The four principles of the campaign are:
1) Sanctity of treaty obligations.
2) Limitation and reduction of armaments and the abolition
of profit from arms manufacture.
3) Strengthening of the League of Nations and the principle of
real collective and mutual assistance against aggression.
4) The creation within the framework of the League of Nations
of a permanent committee or commission to alleviate and abol-
ish situations and tensions of an international character
which result in war.

headquarters at Geneva, would on the other hand, do much to
strengthen the League as it would represent the national committees
which in turn would represent, when the organisation was complete,
the bulk of public opinion in over forty countries.

关于附上的1936年8月22日《每日新闻》文章的译文，本人须报告称，文中提及的绅士是现任美国驻德国大使之子小威廉·爱德华·多德（William Edward DODD, Jr.）。
小W.E.多德三十年前出生于美国弗吉尼亚州阿什兰，是弗吉尼亚州威廉与玛丽学院的教授。在今年暑假期间，他成为了“国际和平运动”的组织者，该运动由罗伯特·塞西尔子爵于1935年在英国发起，并迅速将其影响力扩展至全球。
该运动的四项原则是：
1) 条约义务的神圣性。
2) 限制和裁减军备，并废除武器制造中的利润。
3) 加强国际联盟及针对侵略的真正集体互助原则。

International Peace Movement
Reasons for the Peace Movement.
--------------------------

1. The "scorched sail" policy now carried out by the Chinese Kuomintang
Party is contrary to the principles of humanity. The continental policy
enforced by Japan/by means of war is also objectionable.

2. The National Government, contrary to the principle of political
tutelage, has deceived the Chinese people for over ten years. It has
long ago lost the confidence of the public, and therefore cannot con-
tinue to exist. The Provisional Government and the Central China
Government not only cannot help Japan to save China but may incite the
Kuomintang Government to ruin China.

Method of restoring peace

3. Steps must first be taken in Shanghai to urge refugees to save them-
selves, so that the bellicose officials of both countries will be unable
to hold their positions. Then advantage may be taken of the situation
to organize an International Peace Association and to form a self-
government based on the principle of cosmopolitanism. A movement may
also be started to restore peace between China and Japan and to organize
a pacific government.

4. An announcement calling on the refugees to save themselves, and a
set of regulations for the Peace Association, have been drawn up. Both
are appended hereto. When carrying out the proposed scheme the refugee
salvation movement and the Peace Association must be made to appear like
two distinctly different matters so that Japan may sympathize with our
movement, and Britain and France may afford us assistance. Assistance
is absolutely necessary to enable local residents to take over the
Custom House and to place it under the control of the Peace Association.

Object of the Peace Movement

5. After taking over the Custom House, local residents should endeavour
to put a stop to the Sino-Japanese hostilities. Finally, the Manchu
Emperor Hsuan-t'ung may be invited to return to Peking to resume the
political power of the Ching Dynasty. Then a Republican form of Govern-
ment may be organized on cosmopolitan and democratic principles, to
promote the interests of the public.

和平运动的原因。
--------------------------

1. 中国国民党目前实行的“焦土”政策违背人道主义原则。日本通过战争手段推行的大陆政策也是令人反感的。

2. 国民政府违背政治训政原则，欺骗中国人民已达十余年之久。它早已失去公众的信任，因此无法继续存在。临时政府和华中央政府不仅不能帮助日本拯救中国，反而可能煽动国民党政府毁灭中国。

恢复和平的方法

3. 首先必须在上海采取行动，敦促难民自救，从而使两国的好战官员无法保住职位。然后可以利用这一局势组织一个国际和平协会，并基于世界主义原则组建一个自治政府。还可以发起一场运动，以恢复中日之间的和平并组织一个和平政府。

4. 已起草一份号召难民自救的公告和一套和平协会的规章。两者均附后。在执行拟议方案时，必须使难民自救运动与和平协会看起来像是两件截然不同的事情，以便日本同情我们的运动，而英法两国能向我们提供援助。援助对于让当地居民接管海关并将其置于和平协会控制之下是绝对必要的。

和平运动的目标

5. 接管海关后，当地居民应努力制止中日敌对行动。最后，可以邀请宣统皇帝返回北京，恢复清朝的政治权力。然后可以基于世界主义和民主原则组织共和制政府，以促进公共利益。
